channel.title: Nino Mihilli — Insights
channel.description: Cash flow, pricing, hiring, scaling and deals — practical guidance for founders and business owners from Phoenix entrepreneur Nino Mihilli.

item.title: How to build a small business advisory board before you need one
item.description: Nino Mihilli explains how to build an advisory board for a small business: who to invite, how to structure meetings, compensation, and common mistakes.

item.title: How to get real ROI from AI in a small business
item.description: A practical, no-hype approach to AI for small business owners: where it pays off, how to pick a first project, measure ROI, and avoid common mistakes.

item.title: Small business due diligence checklist: 50 items to verify before you sign
item.description: A practical due diligence checklist for buying a small business, covering financials, customers, employees, operations, legal, and the seller transition.

item.title: Hiring your first executive: a role scorecard and 90-day plan
item.description: Nino Mihilli's practical template for hiring a first executive: write the scorecard, structure interviews, check references, and run the first 90 days.

item.title: The Monday KPI review: 10 numbers every owner should check weekly
item.description: A weekly KPI review template for small business owners: the ten numbers to check every Monday, how to set targets, and how to run the meeting in 30 minutes.

item.title: How to price a service business so growth doesn't kill your margin
item.description: A practical guide to pricing a service business: find your true cost per hour, set a margin floor, and raise prices without losing your best customers.

item.title: How to build a 13-week cash flow forecast (step by step)
item.description: Nino Mihilli walks through building a 13-week cash flow forecast in a simple spreadsheet, with the exact rows, weekly routine, and mistakes to avoid.

item.title: 9 signs your business needs a fractional CFO
item.description: How to tell when your business has outgrown a bookkeeper but isn't ready for a full-time CFO, and what a fractional CFO should actually deliver.
